newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH BANK IPB Q1-Q3 NET CZK 1.2 BLN - AGENCY.
newsitem.headline: CZECH BANK IPB Q1-Q3 NET CZK 1.2 BLN - AGENCY.

text.p: The Czech bank Investicni a Postovni Banka a.s. on Wednesday said its net profit for the first three quarters of the year totalled 1.2 billion crowns, the Czech agency CTK said quoting a bank spokesman.
No further results were given, and IPB officials were not immediately available for additional comment.
The bank, which is one of the country's four largest, has said it expects full year 1996 net profit of 1.6 billion crowns, up from just over one billion crowns last year.
